title: ObserveOps-8.2.8 | Enable Bulk Approval Workflow for NCCM Operations with Device-Level Approval and Execution Tracking
description:
h3. Description

Introduce Bulk Approval Management for NCCM operations to allow a single approval request to represent changes across multiple devices while maintaining device-level approval, execution, audit, reminder, and cancellation capabilities.

Supported operations:
 * Firmware Upgrade
 * Configuration Sync
 * Backup Restore
 * Runbook Execution

The system shall support selective approval and rejection at the device level within a bulk request.
h1. Business Cases
h3. 1. Large Scale Change Management

A network administrator executes a runbook against 100 devices. Instead of generating 100 approval requests, the system generates a single bulk approval request.
h3. 2. Risk-Based Approval

An approver reviews the requested changes and approves only 40 devices while keeping 60 devices pending for further verification.
h3. 3. Device-Level Governance

Different devices within the same bulk request may have different approval outcomes while maintaining a single approval workflow.
h3. 4. Audit & Compliance

Every device maintains its own approval decision, approver comments, execution status, and audit trail.
h3. 5. Request Follow-Up

Requesters can send reminders only for devices that remain pending without affecting approved or rejected devices.
h1. Acceptance Criteria
h2. Bulk Request Creation
h3. AC1

When a user executes an NCCM operation against multiple devices, the system shall generate a single Bulk Approval Request.
h3. AC2

The bulk request shall display a *Bulk* badge in the approval listing.
h3. AC3

The parent request shall display aggregated counters:
 * Pending X
 * Approved Y
 * Rejected Z

Example:
{{Pending 20 | Approved 50 | Rejected 30}}
h2. Approver Workflow
h3. AC4

Clicking a bulk request shall open a drawer containing all devices associated with the request.
h3. AC5

Approver shall be able to:
 * Select All Pending Devices
 * Select Individual Pending Devices
 * Select Multiple Pending Devices

h3. AC6

Already approved devices shall be displayed but shall be disabled from selection.
h3. AC7

Already rejected devices shall be displayed but shall be disabled from selection.
h3. AC8

Only pending devices shall remain selectable.
h2. Change Review
h3. AC9

Approver shall be able to click any device name.
h3. AC10

The system shall display the requested change comparison for the selected device.
h3. AC11

The comparison view shall use the same experience available in existing single-device approvals.
h2. Approval Action
h3. AC12

Approver shall be able to approve selected pending devices.
h3. AC13

Approval comment shall be mandatory.
h3. AC14

After approval:
 * Device status becomes Approved.
 * Requested task executes automatically.
 * Execution status is recorded.

h3. AC15

Approved devices shall no longer be selectable.
h2. Rejection Action
h3. AC16

Approver shall be able to reject selected pending devices.
h3. AC17

Rejection comment shall be mandatory.
h3. AC18

Rejected devices shall never execute.
h3. AC19

Rejected devices shall no longer be selectable.
h2. Pending Device Handling
h3. AC20

When only a subset of devices is approved or rejected, remaining devices shall continue to stay in Pending state.
h3. AC21

The bulk request shall continue to appear in the Pending Approval screen until all devices reach either Approved or Rejected status.
h3. AC22

Approvers may revisit the same bulk request multiple times to process remaining pending devices.
h2. Requester Workflow
h3. AC23

Requesters shall only see requests created by them.
h3. AC24

Clicking a bulk request shall display all underlying device requests.
h3. AC25

Requester shall be able to:
 * Select All Pending Devices
 * Select Individual Pending Devices
 * Select Multiple Pending Devices

h3. AC26

Requester shall be able to send reminders only for pending devices.
h3. AC27

Requester shall be able to cancel only pending devices.
h3. AC28

Approved devices cannot be cancelled.
h3. AC29

Rejected devices cannot be cancelled.
h3. AC30

Cancelled devices shall not execute.
h2. Audit & Tracking
h3. AC31

Each device shall maintain:
 * Requester
 * Approver
 * Approval Comment
 * Rejection Comment
 * Approval Time
 * Rejection Time
 * Execution Time
 * Operation Type

h3. AC32

Parent bulk request shall maintain aggregated audit history.
h3. AC33

Individual device requests shall maintain device-level audit history.
h2. Status Handling
h3. AC34

Parent request status shall be calculated dynamically:
||Condition||Parent Status||
|At least one device pending|Pending|
|No pending devices and all approved|Approved|
|No pending devices and all rejected|Rejected|
|No pending devices and mixed approved/rejected|Completed|
h3. AC35

Status counters shall update immediately after every approval or rejection action.
h1. Filter :

all the screen we show all the possible filter option.
h1. Definition of Done (DoD)
h3. Functional
 * Bulk approval request creation completed.
 * Device-level selection completed.
 * Partial approval completed.
 * Partial rejection completed.
 * Pending device re-processing completed.
 * Reminder functionality completed.
 * Cancellation functionality completed.
 * Device comparison view integrated.
 * Automatic task execution after approval completed.

h3. Audit
 * Device-level audit logs generated.
 * Parent request audit logs generated.
 * Approval comments captured.
 * Rejection comments captured.

h3. Security
 * Only NCCM approvers can approve or reject requests.
 * Requesters cannot approve requests.
 * Existing RBAC permissions remain intact.

h3. Performance
 * Bulk request supports at least 1,000 devices.
 * Device drawer loads within acceptable response time.
 * Status counters update without page refresh.

h3. Regression
 * Existing single-device approval workflow remains unchanged.
 * Firmware Upgrade approval works.
 * Sync approval works.
 * Restore approval works.
 * Runbook approval works.
